description: This file defines a PHP interface `ValueXNormalizable` within the `OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField` namespace. It includes a method declaration `toArrayXValue` intended for normalizing 'x' values of selected filter fields in report filters.

classes.name: ValueXNormalizable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can normalize 'x' values of selected filter fields in reports.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Defines a method to normalize and return the 'x' value as an array, or null if not applicable.
